lines: Ae jazba-e-dil gar main chahoon, har cheez muqabil aa jaye
couplets.en: O longing of the heart, at my wish all things could come before me.

lines: Manzil ke liye do gaam chaloon, aur saamne manzil aa jaye
couplets.en: I could take two steps and find my destination before me.
O longing of the heart, if I should wish it.

lines: Haan yaad mujhe tum kar lena, aawaaz mujhe tum de lena
couplets.en: Think of me then, and call out to me.

lines: Is raah-e-mohabbat mein koi darpesh jo mushkil aa jaye
couplets.en: Should hardship meet you on this road of love.

lines: Ae dil ki khalish chal yoon hi sahi, chalta to hoon un ki mahfil mein
couplets.en: Come along, heartache, I am going to their gathering all the same.

lines: Us waqt mujhe chaunka dena, jab rang pe mahfil aa jaye
couplets.en: Startle me awake when the gathering comes into its own.
O longing of the heart, if I should wish it.

lines: Ae rahbar-e-kaamil chalne ko, tayyaar to hoon par yaad rahe
couplets.en: O sure guide, I am ready to set out, but remember this.

lines: Us waqt mujhe bhatka dena, jab saamne manzil aa jaye
couplets.en: Lead me astray the moment my destination comes into view.
O longing of the heart, if I should wish it.
